words.gloss: powder of śirīṣa, udumbara and śamī

hindi: शिरीष, उदुम्बर और शमी का चूर्ण घी के साथ मिलाकर: आधे मास का क्षुद्-योग।
english: Having combined powder of śirīṣa, udumbara and śamī with ghee: the half-month hunger preparation.
notes: śirīṣa, udumbara, śamī are tree names; not identified. kṣud-yoga rendered literally as 'hunger preparation' (yoga = preparation, as in the rest of this chapter); the e-text gives no verb. ardha-māsika = lasting/for half a month. The edition joins saṃhṛtya-ardha with '-' (unsandhied join).

words.gloss: cooked with kaśeruka, utpala, tuber, sugarcane, root, lotus-fibre, dūrvā, milk, ghee and maṇḍa

hindi: कशेरुक, उत्पल, कन्द, ईख, मूल, बिस, दूर्वा, दूध, घी और मण्ड के साथ पकाया हुआ मासिक योग।
english: Cooked with kaśeruka, utpala, tuber, sugarcane, root, lotus-fibre, dūrvā, milk, ghee and maṇḍa: the monthly [preparation].
notes: 'kandekṣu' is split kanda + ikṣu (tuber, sugarcane); the alternative is a single plant name. maṇḍa is left as maṇḍa (scum/cream or rice-water are possible senses). The final noun (yoga) is supplied in brackets in English; Hindi says मासिक योग following unit 1. The list may also be read as '(in) the maṇḍa of milk and ghee'.

words.gloss: powder of roots of māṣa, yava, kulattha and darbha
paste of roots of sāla and pṛśniparṇī

hindi: उड़द, जौ, कुलत्थ और दर्भ की जड़ों का चूर्ण दूध और घी के साथ, या लता, दूध और घी समान भाग में पकाया हुआ, या साल और पृश्निपर्णी की जड़ों के कल्क को दूध के साथ पीकर, या उससे पकाया हुआ दूध शहद और घी के साथ खाकर, वह एक मास तक उपवास करता है।
english: Powder of the roots of māṣa, yava, kulattha and darbha with milk and ghee; or creeper, milk and ghee cooked in equal [parts]; or having drunk with milk a paste of the roots of sāla and pṛśniparṇī, or milk cooked with that, having eaten [it] with honey and ghee, he fasts for a month.
notes: The text gives no subject; 'he' is supplied from upavasati. mūla in the first compound could also be read as 'roots' of darbha only; rendered as roots of all four. 'sama-siddham' = cooked in equal [parts] is the literal sense; the e-text splits pṛśni.parṇī as printed. Scope of 'aśitvā' (the powder, or the cooked milk) is not stated.
lines_deva: माष.यव.कुलत्थ.दर्भ.मूल.चूर्णं वा क्षीर.घृताभ्याम्, वल्ली.क्षीर.घृतं वा सम.सिद्धम्, साल.पृश्नि.पर्णी.मूल.कल्कं पयसा पीत्वा, पयो वा तत्.सिद्धं मधु.घृताभ्याम् अशित्वा मासम् उपवसति
lines_iast: māṣa.yava.kulattha.darbha.mūla.cūrṇaṃ vā kṣīra.ghṛtābhyām, vallī.kṣīra.ghṛtaṃ vā sama.siddham, sāla.pṛśni.parṇī.mūla.kalkaṃ payasā pītvā, payo vā tat.siddhaṃ madhu.ghṛtābhyām aśitvā māsam upavasati

words.gloss: in the urine of a white goat
kept a month or half a month

hindi: सफेद बकरे के मूत्र में सात रात रखे गए सिद्धार्थकों के साथ पकाया हुआ तेल, जो कड़वी लौकी में एक मास या आधे मास रखा गया हो, चौपायों और दोपायों को कुरूप करना है।
english: Oil cooked with siddhārthaka [seeds] that have stayed seven nights in the urine of a white goat, and kept a month or half a month in a bitter gourd, is the making misshapen of quadrupeds and bipeds.
notes: siddhārthaka kept as a name, not identified. 'māsa-ardha-māsa' = a month or a half-month. Both 'quadrupeds and bipeds' as literal; sense of 'making misshapen' is virūpa-karaṇa.
lines_deva: श्वेत.बस्त.मूत्रे सप्त.रात्र.उषितैः सिद्ध.अर्थकैः सिद्धं तैलं कटुक.आलाबौ मास.अर्ध.मास.स्थितं चतुष्.पद.द्वि.पदानां विरूप.करणम्
lines_iast: śveta.basta.mūtre sapta.rātra.uṣitaiḥ siddha.arthakaiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ kaṭuka.ālābau māsa.ardha.māsa.sthitaṃ catuṣ.pada.dvi.padānāṃ virūpa.karaṇam

words.gloss: of one whose food is buttermilk and barley

hindi: जो सफेद गधा छाछ और जौ खाता हो, उसकी सात रातों के बाद की लीद के जौ के साथ पकाया हुआ गौर सरसों का तेल कुरूप करना है।
english: After seven nights, the pale mustard oil cooked with the dung-barley of a white donkey whose food is buttermilk and barley is the making misshapen.
notes: leṇḍa = dung; 'leṇḍa-yava' rendered literally as 'dung-barley' (barley grains in the dung is a likely sense, not stated). Hindi uses लीद for leṇḍa. The construction 'sapta-rātrād ūrdhvam' qualifies the feeding: seven nights after it begins; the alternative reading is seven nights after the dung is collected.
lines_deva: तक्र.यव.भक्षस्य सप्त.रात्राद् ऊर्ध्वं श्वेत.गर्दभस्य लेण्ड.यवैः सिद्धं गौर.सर्षप.तैलं विरूप.करणम्
lines_iast: takra.yava.bhakṣasya sapta.rātrād ūrdhvaṃ śveta.gardabhasya leṇḍa.yavaiḥ siddhaṃ gaura.sarṣapa.tailaṃ virūpa.karaṇam

words.gloss: cooked with urine, dung and juice
with an admixture of powder of arka floss and pataṅga

hindi: इन दोनों में से किसी एक के मूत्र, लीद और रस के साथ पकाया हुआ सिद्धार्थक का तेल, जिसमें अर्क की रुई और पतंग का चूर्ण मिलाया गया हो, सफेद करना है।
english: Siddhārthaka oil cooked with the urine, dung and juice of either of these two, with an admixture of powder of arka floss and pataṅga, is the whitening.

text_flags.why: typo: leṇda has dental d (Devanagari द); leṇḍa with retroflex ḍ is used elsewhere in this chunk (units 5, 7)

notes: 'etayor anyatarasya' = of either of these two (the goat and donkey of units 4-5); the animal is not named here. rasa rendered 'juice' literally (Glossary: rasa = poison only in poisoning contexts). arka-tūla = floss of arka (not identified); pataṅga left as name (insect or plant). pratīvāpa = admixture.
lines_deva: एतयोर् अन्यतरस्य मूत्र.लेण्द.रस.सिद्धं सिद्ध.अर्थक.तैलम् अर्क.तूल.पतङ्ग.चूर्ण.प्रतीवापं श्वेती.करणम्
lines_iast: etayor anyatarasya mūtra.leṇda.rasa.siddhaṃ siddha.arthaka.tailam arka.tūla.pataṅga.cūrṇa.pratīvāpaṃ śvetī.karaṇam

words.gloss: preparation of the dung of a white cock and ajagara

hindi: सफेद मुर्गे और अजगर की लीद का योग सफेद करना है।
english: A preparation of the dung of a white cock and of an ajagara is the whitening.
notes: 'śveta' may qualify only kukkuṭa (assumed), or both. ajagara taken literally as the large snake (python); the alternative is a plant name.

words.gloss: in the urine of a white goat

hindi: सफेद बकरे के मूत्र में सात रात रखे गए सफेद सरसों, छाछ, अर्क का दूध, नमक और अनाज, पक्ष भर रखा हुआ यह योग सफेद करना है।
english: White mustard seeds [kept] seven nights in the urine of a white goat, buttermilk, arka milk, salt and grain: the preparation kept for a fortnight is the whitening.

text_flags.why: possible: the editors' doubt mark; 'astakra(?).marka' read as 'uṣitās takra' + 'arka' (stray m); not certain

notes: Damaged token (the editors mark '(?)'). Reading uṣitāḥ + takra + arka-kṣīra + lavaṇa is only a possible repair; the English brackets show a supplied 'kept'. Alternative: 'astakra' is a different word. 'arka milk' = milky sap or milk of arka (plant not identified).
lines_deva: श्वेत.बस्त.मूत्रे श्वेत.सर्षपाः सप्त.रात्र.उषित.अस्तक्र(?).मर्क.क्षीर.लवणं धान्यं च पक्ष.स्थितो योगः श्वेती.करणम्
lines_iast: śveta.basta.mūtre śveta.sarṣapāḥ sapta.rātra.uṣita.astakra(?).marka.kṣīra.lavaṇaṃ dhānyaṃ ca pakṣa.sthito yogaḥ śvetī.karaṇam

words.gloss: kept until half a month has passed

hindi: कड़वी लौकी में, जो झुर्रीदार हो गई हो, आधा मास बीतने तक रखा हुआ पिसा हुआ गौर सरसों रोमों को सफेद करना है।
english: Ground pale mustard, kept in a bitter gourd that has gone to wrinkles until half a month has passed, is the whitening of hairs.

text_flags.why: possible: the anusvāra after gata looks like a typo for a compound join (gata-ardha)
possible: valī (fold, wrinkle) is rendered literally; vallī (creeper) is the alternative

notes: 'valī-gate' is obscure: rendered literally as 'gone to wrinkles' (i.e. wrinkled); alternative 'gone to creepers/vine'. 'gata-ardha-māsa-sthita' read as 'kept [until] half a month has gone'; alternative 'kept for a half-month'.
lines_deva: कटुक.अलाबौ वली.गते गतं.अर्ध.मास.स्थितं गौर.सर्षप.पिष्टं रोम्णां श्वेती.करणम्
lines_iast: kaṭuka.alābau valī.gate gataṃ.ardha.māsa.sthitaṃ gaura.sarṣapa.piṣṭaṃ romṇāṃ śvetī.karaṇam

hindi: जो कीट अलोजुन कहलाता है और सफेद गृह-गोलिका, इस पिसे हुए से लेप किए गए केश शंख के समान श्वेत हो जाएँ।
english: The insect that is called alojuna, and the white house-golikā: hairs anointed with this, [once] ground, would be conch-white.

text_flags.why: typo: piṣtena has dental t (पिष्तेन); piṣṭena (retroflex ṭ) is expected

notes: 'alojuneti' = alojuna + iti; alojuna is a name, not identified. 'gṛha-golikā' kept literally (house-golikā); a house-lizard is a possible sense but is not stated. The ground mass is of the insect and the golikā together (not stated). 'abhyaktāḥ' with '-' is an unsandhied join in the e-text.
lines_deva: अलोजुनेति यः कीटः श्वेता च गृह.गोलिका
lines_iast: alojuneti yaḥ kīṭaḥ śvetā ca gṛha.golikā

words.gloss: with a paste of tinduka and ariṣṭa
of one whose limbs are rubbed

hindi: जिसके अंग गोबर से या तिन्दुक और अरिष्ट के कल्क से मले गए हों और भल्लातक के रस से लेप किए गए हों, उसके लिए मासिक कुष्ठ-योग।
english: For one whose limbs are rubbed with cow-dung or with a paste of tinduka and ariṣṭa, and smeared with bhallātaka juice: the monthly kuṣṭha preparation.
notes: tinduka, ariṣṭa, bhallātaka are plant names; not identified. rasa = juice. kuṣṭha kept as kuṣṭha. 'For one whose ...' follows the genitives mardita-aṅgasya / anuliptasya; the construction is elliptical.
lines_deva: गोमयेन तिन्दुक.अरिष्ट.कल्केन वा मर्दित.अङ्गस्य भल्लातक.रस.अनुलिप्तस्य मासिकः कुष्ठ.योगः
lines_iast: gomayena tinduka.ariṣṭa.kalkena vā mardita.aṅgasya bhallātaka.rasa.anuliptasya māsikaḥ kuṣṭha.yogaḥ

words.gloss: in the mouth of a black snake
in the mouth of a house-golikā

hindi: काले सर्प के मुख में या गृह-गोलिका के मुख में सात रात रखी गई गुञ्जाएँ कुष्ठ-योग हैं।
english: Guñjā [seeds] that have stayed seven nights in the mouth of a black snake or in the mouth of a house-golikā: a kuṣṭha preparation.

text_flags.why: possible: gujjā may be a genuine Prakrit-like form; guñjā is the standard spelling

notes: guñjā seeds kept as name, not identified; 'seeds' is the usual sense but is a supplied word and is not stated in the text — rendered 'guñjā [seeds]'.
lines_deva: कृष्ण.सर्प.मुखे गृह.गोलिका.मुखे वा सप्त.रात्र.उषिता गुज्जाः कुष्ठ.योगः
lines_iast: kṛṣṇa.sarpa.mukhe gṛha.golikā.mukhe vā sapta.rātra.uṣitā gujjāḥ kuṣṭha.yogaḥ

words.gloss: anointing with parrot bile and egg-juice

hindi: तोते के पित्त और अण्डे के रस का लेप कुष्ठ-योग है।
english: Anointing with parrot's bile and egg-juice: a kuṣṭha preparation.
notes: śuka taken as parrot (could be a plant name); pitta = bile (literal, not the humour). aṇḍa-rasa = egg-juice; whether 'parrot' governs the egg as well as the bile is not stated; alternative: 'bile, egg [and] juice'.

hindi: कुष्ठ का प्रतिकार प्रियाल के कल्क का काढ़ा है।
english: A decoction of priyāla paste is the remedy of kuṣṭha.

text_flags.why: possible: the editors' compound dot after the genitive kuṣṭhasya; it is probably a separate word

notes: priyāla is a plant name, not identified. 'kalka-kaṣāya' = decoction of paste (alternative: paste and decoction). pratīkāra = remedy.

words.gloss: combined with kukkuṭa, kośa, atakī and śatāvarī root

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. caus. ā-√hṛ

hindi: जो कुक्कुट, कोश, अतकी और शतावरी की जड़ से युक्त आहार लेता है, वह एक मास में गौर हो जाता है।
english: One who takes food combined with kukkuṭa, kośa, atakī and the root of śatāvarī becomes fair in a month.

text_flags.why: possible: the editors' doubt mark at atakī; 'kośa.atakī' may be one name, kośātakī

notes: Damaged word (doubt mark on atakī). Rendered literally as separate items; alternative: kukkuṭa and kośātakī (a plant name). 'kukkuṭa' could be the cock or a plant. The English object 'food' is supplied by āhārayamāṇaḥ. 'Man' in Hindi is supplied as the subject.

words.gloss: bathed in a decoction of vaṭa
smeared with a paste of sahacara

hindi: जो वट के काढ़े से स्नान करता है और सहचर के कल्क से लिप्त होता है, वह काला हो जाता है।
english: One bathed in a decoction of vaṭa and smeared with a paste of sahacara becomes dark.
notes: vaṭa and sahacara are plant names, not identified; sahacara literally 'companion'. kṛṣṇa = dark/black.

words.gloss: combined with oil of śakuna and kaṅgu

hindi: शकुन और कङ्गु के तेल से युक्त हरिताल और मनःशिला श्याम करना है।
english: Haritāla and manaḥśilā combined with oil of śakuna and kaṅgu: the making dark-hued.

text_flags.why: typo: kaṇgu has ṇ (कण्गु); kaṅgu (ṅ) is printed in unit 19. Also yuktā (f. sg.) beside plural subject: possibly yuktāḥ

notes: haritāla and manaḥśilā are mineral names, not identified (hari.tāla is split as printed). 'śakuna-kaṅgu-taila' read as oil of śakuna and kaṅgu; alternative: a single oil called 'śakuna-kaṅgu'. śyāma = dark-hued, swarthy.

hindi: खद्योत का चूर्ण सरसों के तेल से युक्त रात में चमकता है।
english: Powder of fireflies combined with mustard oil glows at night.
notes: kha-dyota (sky-luminary) taken as firefly. jvalati = blazes/glows; 'glows' chosen because the context is night.

words.gloss: powder of fireflies and gaṇḍūpada (a worm)
combined with oil of śakuna and kaṅgu

hindi: खद्योत और गण्डूपद का चूर्ण, समुद्री जीवों का, भृङ्ग-कपालों का, या खदिर और कर्णिकार के फूलों का चूर्ण, शकुन और कङ्गु के तेल से युक्त, तेजन चूर्ण है।
english: Powder of fireflies and gaṇḍūpada worms, of sea-creatures, of bhṛṅga kapālas, or powder of the flowers of khadira and karṇikāra, combined with oil of śakuna and kaṅgu: the brightening powder.
notes: gaṇḍū-pada (printed gaṇḍū.pada) = a worm, rendered as the name gaṇḍūpada. bhṛṅga-kapāla taken literally (bhṛṅga: bee/bird/plant; kapāla: skull/shell/potsherd): sense uncertain. 'Puṣpa-cūrṇa' governs only the khadira/karṇikāra flowers by reading; alternative: all items are 'or' alternatives. tejana = brightening/sharpening; rendered 'brightening powder'.
lines_deva: ख.द्योत.गण्डू.पद.चूर्णं समुद्र.जन्तूनां भृङ्ग.कपालानां खदिर.कर्णिकाराणां पुष्प.चूर्णं वा शकुन.कङ्गु.तैल.युक्तं तेजन.चूर्णम्
lines_iast: kha.dyota.gaṇḍū.pada.cūrṇaṃ samudra.jantūnāṃ bhṛṅga.kapālānāṃ khadira.karṇikārāṇāṃ puṣpa.cūrṇaṃ vā śakuna.kaṅgu.taila.yuktaṃ tejana.cūrṇam

words.gloss: soot of the bark of pāribhadraka

hindi: पारिभद्रक की छाल की कालिख, मेंढक की चर्बी से युक्त, अग्नि से अंगों को प्रज्वलित करना है।
english: Soot of pāribhadraka bark, combined with frog fat: the setting of the limbs ablaze with fire.

text_flags.why: typo: tvan for tvak (त्वन्), as tvak is printed in unit 21

notes: pāribhadraka is a tree name, not identified. maṣī = soot/ink; 'soot' is the literal sense, the bark may be burnt. 'Setting ablaze' says the limbs blaze; whether of the user or others is not stated.

words.gloss: smeared with paste of paribhadraka bark and sesame

hindi: परिभद्रक की छाल और तिल के कल्क से लिप्त शरीर अग्नि से जल उठता है।
english: The body smeared with a paste of paribhadraka bark and sesame blazes with fire.
notes: paribhadraka here and pāribhadraka in unit 20 are the same plant name by the context; the print differs (not flagged as a typo). tila = sesame.

words.gloss: made of soot of pīlu bark

hindi: पीलु की छाल की कालिख से बना पिण्ड हाथ में जल उठता है।
english: A lump made of soot of pīlu bark blazes in the hand.
notes: pīlu is a tree name, not identified.

hindi: मेंढक की चर्बी से लिप्त हुआ अग्नि से जल उठता है।
english: [One] smeared with frog fat blazes with fire.
notes: The text gives no noun; 'one' is supplied (the person or the limb as in unit 24). The e-text's "'gninā" is agninā with avagraha after ō.

words.gloss: sprinkled with oil of kuśa and āmra fruit
combined with powder of sea-frog, phenaka and sarja juice

hindi: उससे लिप्त अंग, या कुश और आम्र के फल के तेल से सींचा हुआ, या समुद्री मेंढकी, फेनक और सर्ज के रस के चूर्ण से युक्त अंग जल उठता है।
english: The limb smeared with that, or sprinkled with oil of kuśa and āmra fruit, or combined with powder of sea-frog, phenaka and sarja juice, blazes.
notes: 'tena' refers back to the frog fat of unit 23 (assumed). 'kuśa-āmra-phala-taila' could be oil of the fruit of kuśa and āmra, or oil of kuśa and of āmra fruit. samudra-maṇḍūkī = sea-frog (literal); phenaka and sarja not identified; sarja-rasa = sarja juice/resin (rasa not read as poison here). The alternatives are joined by vā. Reviewer: tena is masc./neut., so it cannot refer to the feminine vasā of unit 23; its referent is unclear (perhaps the oil or the preparation of the preceding units).
lines_deva: तेन प्रदिग्धम् अङ्गं कुश.आम्र.फल.तैल.सिक्तं समुद्र.मण्डूकी.फेनक.सर्ज.रस.चूर्ण.युक्तं वा ज्वलति
lines_iast: tena pradigdham aṅgaṃ kuśa.āmra.phala.taila.siktaṃ samudra.maṇḍūkī.phenaka.sarja.rasa.cūrṇa.yuktaṃ vā jvalati

words.gloss: of frogs, crabs and the like

words.gram: m. acc. sg. (or n. nom. sg.)

hindi: मेंढक, केकड़े आदि की चर्बी के साथ समान भाग में पकाया हुआ तेल, अंगों का लेप, अग्नि को प्रज्वलित करना है।
english: Oil cooked in equal parts with the fat of frogs, crabs and the like, as an anointing of the limbs, is the kindling of fire.
notes: kulīra taken as crab. 'sama-bhāgam' = in equal parts (oil and fat). 'agni-prajvālana' = kindling/blazing of fire; the object (the limbs or the fire) is not stated.
lines_deva: मण्डूक.कुलीर.आदीनां वसया सम.भागं तैलं सिद्धम् अभ्यङ्गं गात्राणाम् अग्नि.प्रज्वालनम्
lines_iast: maṇḍūka.kulīra.ādīnāṃ vasayā sama.bhāgaṃ tailaṃ siddham abhyaṅgaṃ gātrāṇām agni.prajvālanam

words.gloss: coated with bamboo root and śaivala

hindi: बाँस की जड़ और शैवल से लिप्त और मेंढक की चर्बी से लिप्त अंग अग्नि से जल उठता है।
english: The limb coated with bamboo root and śaivala and smeared with frog fat blazes with fire.
notes: veṇu taken as bamboo; śaivala (water-plant) kept as name. Whether veṇu-mūla-śaivala is 'root of bamboo and śaivala' or 'root of bamboo, śaivala' is not marked.

words.gloss: with a paste of the roots of pāribhadraka, pratibalā, vañjula, vajra and kadalī

hindi: पारिभद्रक, प्रतिबला, वञ्जुल, वज्र और कदली की जड़ों के कल्क और मेंढक की चर्बी के साथ पकाए गए तेल से जिसके पैर लिप्त हों, वह अंगारों पर चलता है।
english: One whose feet are anointed with oil cooked with a paste of the roots of pāribhadraka, pratibalā, vañjula, vajra and kadalī and with frog fat goes on embers.

text_flags.why: typo: ppatibalā for pratibalā (as printed in unit 28)

notes: All plant names, not identified. 'mūla' may belong to all five names or only kadalī. The construction kalkena ... siddhena tailena can also be read 'with oil cooked with the paste and frog fat'; the English keeps both instrumentals. 'tailena-abhyakta' is an unsandhied join in the e-text.

words.gloss: with a paste of the roots

hindi: उपोदका, प्रतिबला, वञ्जुल और पारिभद्रक, इनकी जड़ों के कल्क और मेंढक की चर्बी के साथ
english: Upodakā, pratibalā, vañjula and pāribhadraka: with the root-paste of these, together with frog fat ...
notes: Plant names, not identified (upa.udakā is printed split; upodakā). The sentence continues in unit 29 (sādhayet tailam ...): GROUPING: units 28 and 29 form one sentence; the translation here ends where the unit ends.

hindi: तेल को पकाए; इससे दोनों साफ़ पैरों को लिप्त करके वह अंगारों की राशि में ऐसे विचरे जैसे फूलों के ढेर में।
english: [One] should cook oil; having anointed the two clean feet with this, he may walk about in a heap of embers as in a heap of flowers.
notes: Continues unit 28. 'nirmalau' = clean (free of dirt); rendered literally. The subject 'one/he' is supplied from the verb forms.
lines_deva: साधयेत् तैलम् एतेन पादाव् अभ्यज्य निर्मलौ
lines_iast: sādhayet tailam etena pādāv abhyajya nirmalau

words.gloss: of swans, krauñca birds and peacocks

hindi: हंस, क्रौञ्च और मयूरों की, या जल पर तैरने वाले अन्य बड़े पक्षियों की पूँछों में बँधी नरकट की मशाल रात में उल्का दिखाना है।
english: A reed torch tied to the tails of swans, krauñca birds and peacocks, or of other large birds that float on water, is the showing of meteors at night.
notes: krauñca = a wading bird (kept as krauñca). ulkā = meteor or firebrand; 'meteors' chosen. 'udaka-plavānām' may qualify only 'other' birds (as rendered) or all.
lines_deva: हंस.क्रौञ्च.मयूराणाम् अन्येषां वा महा.शकुनीनाम् उदक.प्लवानां पुच्छेषु बद्धा नल.दीपिका रात्राव् उल्का.दर्शनम्
lines_iast: haṃsa.krauñca.mayūrāṇām anyeṣāṃ vā mahā.śakunīnām udaka.plavānāṃ puccheṣu baddhā nala.dīpikā rātrāv ulkā.darśanam

words.gram: cpd. n. nom. sg. (bhasma + agni-śamana, with aṅgi corrected to agni)

hindi: बिजली से उत्पन्न भस्म अग्नि को शान्त करने वाली है।
english: The ash from lightning is the quencher of fire.

text_flags.why: possible: aṅgi (अङ्गि) is probably a misprint for agni

notes: With the correction the line reads 'vaidyutaṃ bhasma agni-śamanam' (ash from lightning, quencher of fire). If aṅgi is kept, no sense is available; the words field gives the corrected form agni.

words.gloss: made to drink the flower of women

hindi: स्त्री-पुष्प पिलाए गए उड़द और मेंढक की चर्बी मिली हुई व्रजकुली की जड़ जलते हुए चूल्हे पर न पकना है।
english: Māṣa beans made to drink women's flower, and the root of vrajakulī mixed with frog fat, on a blazing hearth: the non-cooking.

text_flags.why: possible: culluyāṃ is not a regular locative of cullī; cullyām (or cullīyām) expected

notes: strī-puṣpa literally 'women's flower'; in Sanskrit usage a term for the menstrual flow, kept literal. māṣa beans are a common sense of māṣa; vrajakulī not identified. apācana = non-cooking (i.e. the pot does not cook).
lines_deva: स्त्री.पुष्प.पायिता माषा व्रजकुली.मूलं मण्डूक.वसा.मिश्रं चुल्लुयां दीप्तायाम् अपाचनम्
lines_iast: strī.puṣpa.pāyitā māṣā vrajakulī.mūlaṃ maṇḍūka.vasā.miśraṃ culluyāṃ dīptāyām apācanam

hindi: चूल्हे की सफ़ाई प्रतिकार है।
english: The cleaning of the hearth is the remedy.
notes: Remedy to unit 32 (the non-cooking). Here cullī is the standard form; unit 32 prints culluyāṃ.

hindi: पीलु से बनी हुई मणि, जिसके भीतर अग्नि हो, या सुवर्चला की जड़ की गाँठ, या सूत की गाँठ, पिचु में लिपटी हुई, मुख से अग्नि और धुएँ का निकलना है।
english: A jewel made of pīlu with fire inside, or a knot of suvarcalā root, or a knot of thread, wrapped in picu: the emission of fire and smoke from the mouth.

text_flags.why: possible: mukhya (principal) is unlikely; mukhāt (from the mouth) expected

notes: The e-text's mukhyād is rendered 'from the mouth' (mukhāt). picu is kept as picu (cotton or a tree name). suvarcalā not identified. The nominative list (jewel, knot, knot) has no verb; the compound 'emission' is the predicate.
lines_deva: पीलुमयो मणिर् अग्नि.गर्भः सुवर्चला.मूल.ग्रन्थिः सूत्र.ग्रन्थिर् वा पिचु.परिवेष्टितो मुख्याद् अग्नि.धूम.उत्सर्गः
lines_iast: pīlumayo maṇir agni.garbhaḥ suvarcalā.mūla.granthiḥ sūtra.granthir vā picu.pariveṣṭito mukhyād agni.dhūma.utsargaḥ

words.gloss: sprinkled with oil of kuśa and āmra fruit

hindi: कुश और आम्र के फल के तेल से सींची हुई अग्नि वर्षा और हवाओं में जलती है।
english: Fire sprinkled with oil of kuśa and āmra fruit blazes in rain and winds.
notes: As in unit 24, the oil may be of the fruit of both kuśa and āmra, or of kuśa and of āmra fruit. 'pravāta' = wind / windy place.

hindi: तेल से युक्त समुद्र-फेनक जल पर तैरता हुआ जलता है।
english: Sea-foam combined with oil, floating on water, blazes.
notes: samudra-phenaka (literal 'sea-foam') is the literal rendering; it may name a substance. See phenaka in unit 24.

hindi: तैरने वालों की हड्डियों पर चितकबरे बाँस से मथकर निकाली गई अग्नि जल से शान्त नहीं होती, जल से जल उठती है।
english: Fire churned out on the bones of floating [creatures] with a mottled bamboo is not quenched by water; it blazes with water.
notes: 'plavamānānām' is rendered literally as 'of floating [creatures]'; it may mean water-birds or other floaters. kalmāṣa = mottled, spotted. 'na-udakena' is an unsandhied join in the e-text.
lines_deva: प्लवमानानाम् अस्थिषु कल्माष.वेणुना निर्मथितो ऽग्निर् न-उदकेन शाम्यति, उदकेन ज्वलति
lines_iast: plavamānānām asthiṣu kalmāṣa.veṇunā nirmathito 'gnir na-udakena śāmyati, udakena jvalati

words.gloss: of one killed by a weapon
of one impaled on a stake

hindi: शस्त्र से मारे गए या शूल पर चढ़ाए गए पुरुष की बाईं पसलियों की हड्डियों पर चितकबरे बाँस से मथकर निकाली गई अग्नि, स्त्री या पुरुष की हड्डियों पर मनुष्य की पसली से मथकर निकाली गई अग्नि जहाँ तीन बार अपसव्य दिशा में जाती है, वहाँ कोई दूसरी अग्नि नहीं जलती।
english: The fire churned out with a mottled bamboo on the left-side rib bones of a man killed by a weapon or impaled on a stake; the fire churned out on the bones of a woman or a man with a human rib: where it goes thrice in the apasavya (anticlockwise) direction, no other fire blazes there.
notes: The sentence has two kinds of fire; 'yatra' clause applies to the second (assumed), possibly both. apasavya = to the left/anticlockwise, kept with the gloss in English. 'vā-asthiṣu' and 'ca-atra-anyo' are unsandhied joins in the e-text. 'ca-atra' = 'and here'.
lines_deva: शस्त्र.हतस्य शूल.प्रोतस्य वा पुरुषस्य वाम.पार्श्व.पर्शुक.अस्थिषु कल्माष.वेणुना निर्मथितो ऽग्निः स्त्रियाः पुरुषस्य वा-अस्थिषु मनुष्य.पर्शुकया निर्मथितो ऽग्निर् यत्र त्रिर् अपसव्यं गच्छति न च-अत्र-अन्यो ऽग्निर् ज्वलति
lines_iast: śastra.hatasya śūla.protasya vā puruṣasya vāma.pārśva.parśuka.asthiṣu kalmāṣa.veṇunā nirmathito 'gniḥ striyāḥ puruṣasya vā-asthiṣu manuṣya.parśukayā nirmathito 'gnir yatra trir apasavyaṃ gacchati na ca-atra-anyo 'gnir jvalati

hindi: चुच्चुन्दरी, खञ्जरीट और खार कीट पीसे जाते हैं; घोड़े के मूत्र से मिला हुआ यह बेड़ियों को तोड़ना है।
english: Cuccundarī, khañjarīṭa and the khāra insect are ground; mixed with horse urine, it is the breaking of fetters.
notes: cuccundarī and khañjarīṭa are kept as names (a small animal and a bird are usual senses, not stated). khāra-kīṭa = 'khāra insect'. saṃsṛṣṭā (f. sg.) agrees with an implied preparation. The singular verb piṣyate follows the last subject.

words.gloss: by smearing with the fat of crab, dardura and khāra insect

hindi: या अयस्कान्त पत्थर केकड़े, दर्दुर और खार कीट की चर्बी के लेप से दुगुना हो जाता है।
english: Or an ayaskānta stone is doubled by smearing with the fat of crab, dardura and khāra insect.
notes: ayas-kānta kept as ayaskānta (literally 'iron-lovely'); 'doubled' for dvi-guṇa is literal, the respect in which it is doubled is not stated. dardura taken as a frog (alternative: a name). The e-text prints ayas.kānto with a dot (compound member).

words.gloss: ground with kaṅka, bhāsa, pārśva, utpala and water

hindi: नारक-गर्भ, कङ्क, भास, पार्श्व, उत्पल और जल के साथ पिसा हुआ, चौपायों और दोपायों के पैरों का लेप है।
english: The nāraka-garbha, ground with kaṅka, bhāsa, pārśva, utpala and water, is the smearing of the feet of quadrupeds and bipeds.
notes: Obscure: nāraka-garbha is rendered as an untranslated name (literally 'womb/inside of nāraka'). kaṅka and bhāsa are names of birds in other contexts, pārśva means 'side', utpala 'lotus': the list is kept literal and not interpreted; 'the sides of kaṅka and bhāsa' is a possible alternative. The ś of piṣṭaś is sandhi for piṣṭaḥ.

words.gloss: with the fat of owl and vulture

hindi: उल्लू और गिद्ध की चर्बी से ऊँट के चमड़े के दोनों जूतों पर लेप करके और उन्हें वट के पत्तों से ढककर वह पचास योजन बिना थके चलता है।
english: Having anointed a pair of shoes of camel hide with the fat of owl and vulture, [and] having covered [them] with leaves of vaṭa, he goes fifty yojanas untired.
notes: vaṭa taken as the tree name (not otherwise identified). The e-text spells the leaves 'pattra' (variant of patra); no flag. The pair of shoes is the dual object; 'them' is supplied in brackets. Subject 'he' comes from gacchati.
lines_deva: उलूक.गृध्र.वसाभ्याम् उष्ट्र.चर्म.उपानहाव् अभ्यज्य वटपत्त्रैः प्रतिच्छाद्य पञ्चाशद्.योजनान्य् अश्रान्तो गच्छति
lines_iast: ulūka.gṛdhra.vasābhyām uṣṭra.carma.upānahāv abhyajya vaṭapattraiḥ praticchādya pañcāśad.yojanāny aśrānto gacchati

words.gloss: of hawk, kaṅka, crow, vulture, swan, krauñca, vīcī and ralla
of lion, tiger, dvīpa, crow and owl

hindi: बाज, कङ्क, कौए, गिद्ध, हंस, क्रौञ्च, वीची और रल्ल की मज्जाएँ या वीर्य सौ योजन के लिए; अथवा सिंह, बाघ, द्वीप, कौए और उल्लू की मज्जाएँ या वीर्य।
english: Of hawk, kaṅka, crow, vulture, swan, krauñca, vīcī and ralla, the marrows or the semens, for [going] a hundred yojanas; or of lion, tiger, dvīpa, crow and owl, the marrows or the semens.
notes: Elliptical: no verb; the context of unit 42 (travelling untired) is not imported into the translation except in the bracket 'going'. vīcī and ralla (printed vīcī.rallānām) are kept as names. dvīpa probably a big cat (leopard) but kept as dvīpa. The second list repeats kāka and ulūka.
lines_deva: श्येन.कङ्क.काक.गृध्र.हंस.क्रौञ्च.वीची.रल्लानां मज्जानो रेतांसि वा योजन.शताय, सिंह.व्याघ्र.द्वीप.काक.उलूकानां मज्जानो रेतांसि वा
lines_iast: śyena.kaṅka.kāka.gṛdhra.haṃsa.krauñca.vīcī.rallānāṃ majjāno retāṃsi vā yojana.śatāya, siṃha.vyāghra.dvīpa.kāka.ulūkānāṃ majjāno retāṃsi vā

words.gram: abs. (abhi-√sū 'bring forth' is the regular source; abhi-√su 'press, soak' would give abhiṣutya; sense uncertain)

hindi: सब वर्णों के गर्भपातों को उष्ट्रिका में भिगोकर, श्मशान में, या मृत शिशुओं को, उससे उत्पन्न मेद सौ योजन के लिए।
english: Having steeped in an uṣṭrikā fetuses fallen from [women of] all classes, in the cremation ground, or dead infants, the fat arisen from that [serves] for [going] a hundred yojanas.
notes: Obscure. 'abhiṣūya' is taken as an absolutive of abhi-√su (steep, soak); an alternative is √sū (bring forth), giving 'having caused to bring forth'. uṣṭrikā kept as a word (she-camel or camel-hide vessel). 'sārvavarṇika' = of all classes; 'of women' is supplied in brackets. Where 'in the cremation ground' attaches is not clear. The predicate is supplied in brackets. Reviewer: abhiṣūya is the regular absolutive of abhi-√sū (bring forth); abhi-√su would give abhiṣutya. The English 'having steeped' and Hindi भिगोकर follow the √su reading and are not secure; a person should decide.
lines_deva: सार्ववर्णिकानि गर्भ.पतनान्य् उष्ट्रिकायाम् अभिषूय श्मशाने प्रेत.शिशून् वा तत्.समुत्थितं मेदो योजन.शताय
lines_iast: sārvavarṇikāni garbha.patanāny uṣṭrikāyām abhiṣūya śmaśāne preta.śiśūn vā tat.samutthitaṃ medo yojana.śatāya

hindi: अनिष्ट, अद्भुत उत्पातों से शत्रु में उद्वेग उत्पन्न करे। “आराज्य के लिए”— निर्वाद को समान क्रोध कहा जाता है।
english: By undesirable, marvellous portents one should bring about agitation of the enemy. "For ārājya"—the nirvāda is called equal anger.
notes: Second line is obscure. 'ārājya' (printed ārājyāya-iti) kept as a word; nirvāda is taken as a blame or denunciation, not certain; 'samāna kopa' = equal anger (kopa may also be revolt as in 8.2). 'ācaret' = one should practise/bring about. Both '-' joins (parasya-udvegam, ārājyāya-iti) are unsandhied joins in the e-text. The line may be the closing verse of the chapter.
